title: Shams means sun, and we light up your road
story: “Shams” means “sun” in Arabic. Like the sun, we bring light and warmth to your trip: we design the route, arrange transport and stays, and introduce you to an experienced guide. All that's left for you is to enjoy the road.

values.item_1_text: Attention and a warm welcome for every guest
values.item_2_text: Prices and plans are open and easy to understand
values.item_3_text: We fit the trip to your time and budget
values.item_4_text: We deliver on our promises to the end

cta_subtitle: Browse the tours — one of them is surely yours
